inclusion_rule: Include studies that evaluate speech synthesized from non-acoustic signals (neural activity, EMG, articulatory measurements such as EMA or PMA, ultrasound, mouth video) with an intelligibility test in which human listeners transcribe it or identify words or sentences from a set of choices, and report accuracy, WER or similar. Boundary: exclude those with only naturalness, preference or MOS ratings. Exclude conversion from acoustic input (whisper, NAM microphone, esophageal speech, etc.). Exclude synthesis from text and stimulus sounds for perception experiments. Exclude those that evaluate synthesized speech only with automatic speech recognition. Exclude matches in reviews or citations only. Count different versions of the same study as one item.
